exposure: observed/expected lung area-to-head circumference ratio (o/e LHR)
outcome: developmental outcomes at 3 years of age
cohort: The study included 196 patients with isolated congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) (no other malformations) born between 2010 and 2016 in seven facilities in Japan.
finding: Isolated congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) survivors generally demonstrate good developmental outcomes at 3 years, but a lower observed/expected lung area-to-head circumference ratio (o/e LHR) is an independent predictor of a developmental quotient (DQ) score < 85.
